title: "HPA Quarto document"
author: "Daniel Booker"
---
We are looking for the mammal with the greatest number of regionally elevated genes in the forebrain.
Human:
```{r}
elev_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(paste("Humans have", elev_human, "elevated genes in the forebrain."))
```
Pig:
```{r}
elev_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(paste("Pigs have", elev_pig, "elevated genes in the forebrain."))
```
Mouse:
```{r}
elev_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("Mice have", elev_mouse, "elevated genes in the forebrain."))
```
So humans have the most elevated genes in the forebrain.
